instruction: I want to update my presentation by changing all text to 'Liberation Sans' font and making it bold. How can I do this without manually selecting each text element?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all fonts to Liberation Sans and making all text bold. Evaluator verifies both conditions with partial credit: 0.5 for correct font, 0.5 for all bold.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 points for using only Liberation Sans font, 0.5 points for all text being bold

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Both instruction requirements (Liberation Sans font and bold text) are verified
Correct state extraction: Getter properly iterates through all text elements at the run level (most granular formatting level)
Correct comparison logic: Font check uses set equality to ensure ONLY Liberation Sans is used; bold check verifies all text runs are bold
Appropriate postconfig: File is saved with Ctrl+S to persist changes before verification
Proper data flow: Getter extracts fonts and bold status → Metric compares against expected values → Returns appropriate score
Sensible partial credit: 0.5 for correct font + 0.5 for all bold matches the stated scoring breakdown
Expected value is semantically correct: 'Liberation Sans' matches the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter returns all_bold=False when total_count=0 (empty presentation). This is logically correct but could be clarified in documentation
Minor: Getter only adds fonts to fonts_used when run.font.name is not None. This should work correctly with python-pptx's effective font name resolution, but worth noting as a potential edge case
